summary.headline: Venky's Q4 FY26 margins jumped on broiler realisation; poultry EBIT margin ~14% and Animal Health ~29%, but April–May broiler and chick prices softened.
summary.overview: Management said Q4 FY26 improved substantially, driven by better realisation on day-old chicks and broilers, with poultry margins near 14% and Animal Health EBIT margin around 29%. Oil Seed capacity utilisation rose to 65–70%, with a target of about 80% this year and a push to lift outside-group sales to roughly 60–65% of revenue. Management flagged that broiler realisation and chick prices fell from 10–11 May, and maize and soya prices are expected to stay volatile. Full-year FY26 volumes were mixed: commercial broiler birds fell to 8.69 crore from 9.17 crore, while layer chicks rose to 4.57 crore from 4.38 crore.

financial_highlights.metric: Q4 FY26 day-old broiler chick realisation

segments.name: Poultry
segments.commentary: Q4 operating margin ~14% on broiler realisation and input costs. Q1 FY27 to date (April) broiler ~INR97–100/kg, chicks INR38–39, layer chicks INR46; prices softening from mid-May. Cost of production ~INR89/kg for broilers, INR32–33 for broiler chicks, INR35–37 for layer chicks.

segments.name: Animal Health (AHP)
segments.commentary: Management said FY26 turnover was about INR100 crore and EBIT margin was around 29% in Q4; guidance is 22–23%+ for the full year FY27 and double-digit growth. Kesurdi plant runs at 75–80% utilisation and the new therapeutic plant at 35–40%. Exports are under 2–3% of turnover.

segments.name: Oil Seed
segments.commentary: Q4 EBIT margin ~5.3%. Capacity utilisation 65–70% now, targeted ~80% this year. Outside-group sales reached ~20% of production, with a target of one-third. Division is debt-free with no capex or working capital borrowings.

segments.name: SPF eggs
segments.commentary: Capacity 1.88 crore eggs/year, utilisation 48% in FY26 (45% prior year), production ~1 crore eggs, realisation INR80.22. Margin not disclosed; to be revisited.

guidance_outlook: Management expects Oil Seed to hold or beat Q4 performance through September, with the Q3 outlook dependent on the new crop and El Nino.
Animal Health expected to grow at double digits in FY27, with margins held at 22–23% or above for the full year.
Layer chick sales targeted above 5 crore in FY27, up from 4.57 crore; broiler chicks and contract broiler farming volumes targeted up 2–5%.
Q1 is seasonally weaker for poultry productivity (10–12% lower in open farms), so management expects softer Q1 volumes.
Management said the company would not add debt; working capital of about INR160 crore is sufficient.
Management said the company would concentrate on balanced yearly rather than quarterly performance.
capex_capacity: Oil Seed: four plants across three units; no new capex until the existing units are stable over the next year.
Animal Health: new therapeutic plant at 35–40% utilisation; Kesurdi plant at 75–80%.
SPF egg capacity 1.88 crore eggs; utilisation 48%.
Oil Seed capacity is counted on 300 working days, so utilisation can rise beyond the stated base.
demand_pricing: Layer prices stable at INR45–49 across Q4 FY26, April and May.
Broiler realisation was INR105–110 in the company's operating region in Q4 and stayed near INR110 in April; it fell from around 10–11 May, with management citing demand-supply factors.
Day-old chick prices reached about INR55 in Q4 and fell to about INR35 in the company's region, and to INR21–22 in parts of North India.
Management cited an industry poultry growth rate of 7–8% and said more than 75% of expansion comes from existing integrators.
Poultry share of the non-veg segment has reportedly risen above 55% from 35–40%.
Maize and soya prices are expected to stay volatile with crude oil and ethanol demand; India is currently priced above global levels, with Brazil and Argentina cheaper.

qa_highlights.question: What are FY26 volumes and realisations by segment?
qa_highlights.answer: Commercial broiler birds 8.69 crore (vs 9.17 crore), layer chicks 4.57 crore (vs 4.38 crore), broiler chicks 11.46 crore (vs 10.77 crore). Realisations: broiler INR89.59/kg, broiler chick INR34.94, layer chick INR45.15.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Q4 and April–May pricing trend?
qa_highlights.answer: Q4 broiler INR102.67/kg, chick INR51.32, layer INR46.15. April broiler ~INR97–100, broiler chick INR38–39, layer chick INR46. Prices began falling from 10–11 May, with broilers near INR90–93 at one point.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Oil Seed margin sustainable and how is it growing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said capacity utilisation has risen over six months, outside-group sales reached 20% of production, and the target is one-third. Margins depend on conversion spread and inventory gains; the Q4 margin has been held.

qa_highlights.question: Will Animal Health margins hold and what drives them?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said margins were driven by a new therapeutic plant, a natural-solutions product mix and wider distribution. It expects 22–23%+ for the full year, with raw material pressure in Q2–Q3.

qa_highlights.question: Is there interest in separately listing Animal Health or doing a buyback?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the portfolio complements the group and the model is working; the company will inform shareholders if anything is decided.

qa_highlights.question: Why has commercial broiler output been flat since FY20?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the company can switch between chicks sold on to open-market farmers and birds grown in its own integration, so volumes shift year to year.

risks_watch: Broiler and chick price falls from mid-May could erode the Q4 margin uplift in Q1 FY27.
Maize and soya volatility, linked to crude oil and biofuel demand, could compress poultry and Oil Seed margins.
The CCI antitrust probe concerns parent breeding farms, but management said the listed entity was not affected for now.
El Nino and seasonal heat could lower Q1 broiler productivity; the Adhik Maas in May could weigh on demand.
Management did not disclose SPF egg margins and said it would revert on the matter.
Receivables remain high at INR544 crore, and related-party exposure is still significant.
summary.management_tone: Confident on Animal Health and Oil Seed trajectory, with specific numerical guidance. More guarded on poultry pricing, pointing to softer April–May realisations and raw material volatility; several questions were deflected (SPF margin, parent-bird competition, separate listing).
key_quotes: So definitely, the productivity will be less in quarter 1.
Now oil is already accounting around 40% of our outside production -- outside sales.
We are debt free. We are not using any money for the capex.
Capacity utilization today is around 65% to 70%. And this year, we expect to be around 80%.

growth.why: Management guides Animal Health double-digit growth and 22-23%+ EBIT margin for FY27, layer chicks 5 crore+ (from 4.57 crore), and Oil Seed utilisation from 65-70% to ~80%, but the brief gives no revenue growth percentage and no new-capacity timeline beyond spare capacity in existing plants.
